title: data/balance.json wholesale reformat (1-space indent, \u-escaped non-ASCII, dropped trailing newline) diverges from every sibling catalog
evidence: New file head (read from worktree): `{` / ` "_comment": "Balance catalog (GDD \u00a7 Numerical Design, ODN-5). Single source for every tunable number...` / ` "logic_hz": 20,` — one-space indent, `§` escaped as \u00a7 (grep -c '\\u' = 6, grep -c '§' = 0), and `tail -c 5` ends `7d` with no `0a`. Sibling data/eras.json line 2: `  "_comment": "Era catalog (Story 6.1, GDD § M4, ODN-5) — th` — two-space indent, raw UTF-8; indent probe shows every other data/*.json at 2-space and the old balance.json (git show 192468d) also 2-space with trailing newline.
detail: JSON load-verified semantically identical except the added `advance` block, so the reformat is pure churn: it inflates the diff (~70 lines touched), breaks the data/ formatting convention, and drops the trailing newline.
recommended_fix: Re-emit balance.json with the original 2-space/raw-UTF-8 formatting and trailing newline, inserting only the `advance` block.
